scripts.build: bun run build:esm && bun run build:cjs
scripts.build:esm: bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/schema/index.ts --outdir ./dist/esm --target node --format esm --external drizzle-orm --external pg
scripts.build:cjs: bun build ./src/index.ts --outfile ./dist/cjs/index.cjs --target node --format cjs --external drizzle-orm --external pg && bun build ./src/schema/index.ts --outfile ./dist/cjs/schema/index.cjs --target node --format cjs --external drizzle-orm --external pg
